mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports a structure-activity inference that Arg7 and its L-configuration are important for maintaining Chex1-Arg20 antibacterial activity against K. pneumoniae.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct molecular target, membrane, ribosome, or DnaK mechanism assay is performed in this paper; the claim is inferred from MIC changes after residue substitution/truncation.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports that Arg20 D-arginine or N-alpha-methyl-arginine substitution retains substantial antibacterial activity relative to other position-7 substitutions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is an activity-retention inference from Table 2 and conclusion text, not direct proof of a molecular mechanism or protease-stability gain in this article.

negative_findings.impact: Mechanism layer is bounded to structure-activity inference; no direct mechanism target is claimed.

extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism wording and replaced pending framework locator text with bounded, non-direct structure-activity mechanism claims supported by this paper.
